lead: A quickfire Showdown, and {winnerClub} cross the line {margin} clear.

lead: {winnerClub} took it, {loserClub} did not, and it was over before anyone blinked.

lead: {winnerPoints} points to {loserPoints}, a result nobody saw coming in the warm-up.

lead: {loserClub} had a lone shot, and it went wide.

lead: The race is over, and {winner} crosses the line with {margin} to spare.

lead: No comeback was needed for {winner}, because there was never time for one.

lead: A quick settle for {winnerClub}, and {loserClub} can only admire the speed.

lead: Not once has {leader} dropped a round, and {trailer} is running short of new ideas.

lead: {leader} is the standard now, and every other manager gets measured against it.

lead: Here is the cruel thing about a dominant run. It makes everyone else doubt themselves.
co: Doubt is an unwelcome passenger, and {trailer} has shared the back seat with it for ages.

lead: Each rival counterattack gets treated by {leader} as a minor inconvenience.
co: Inconveniences are irritating until you run out of patience, and {trailer} is close to empty.

lead: {trailer} has tried every trick in the book, and {leader} has answered each one.

lead: Planning the next campaign already, {leader} leaves the chaser still nursing the last one.

lead: {managerA} and {managerB} have been circling each other for {seasonsTotal} seasons now.

lead: {clubA} against {clubB} has never been a simple affair, and it never will be.

lead: Some rivalries fade with time, but {managerA} and {managerB} only get louder.

lead: {managerB} still brings up that old business with {clubA}, and {managerA} refuses to let it go.

lead: What keeps {managerA} and {managerB} going is simple, and it is pride, plenty of it.
co: Pride is the glue here, and both sides have enough of it to fill a trophy room.

lead: Collisions have followed {clubA} and {clubB} for as long as this Showdown has existed.
co: Collisions leave bruises, and these two keep collecting them season after season.

co: Quitting was never on the menu. The pair would rather keep swinging than admit it.

lead: Ask {managerA} about {managerB} and you will get a sigh, a grin and a full history lesson.

lead: Two managers trade sharp words all the time, yet share a friendship worth keeping.

co: Memory is a weapon in this rivalry, and each keeps sharpening theirs.

lead: The grudges are hardly grudges now, as they have become rituals both look forward to.

lead: {managerA} would never say it aloud, but {managerB} has become a favourite opponent.

lead: {clubA} and {clubB} are raring to go, and both look like they planned all night.

lead: After {seasonsTotal} seasons the rivalry is as hot as ever heading into season {seasonNo}.

lead: Bold promises are flying before the campaign begins, and {managerA} has made a few big ones.
